WITH AssigneeCounts AS (
  SELECT 
    GET_PATH(assignee, '[0].name') AS assignee_name,
    SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(filing_date), 1, 4) AS filing_year,
    COUNT(*) AS app_count
  FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS,
  LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => cpc) AS cpc_flatten
  WHERE GET_PATH(cpc_flatten.value, 'code')::STRING LIKE 'A61%'
    AND GET_PATH(assignee, '[0].name') IS NOT NULL
    AND filing_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY GET_PATH(assignee, '[0].name'), SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(filing_date), 1, 4)
),
TopAssignee AS (
  SELECT 
    assignee_name
  FROM AssigneeCounts
  GROUP BY assignee_name
  ORDER BY SUM(app_count) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
TopAssigneeYearlyCounts AS (
  SELECT 
    filing_year,
    app_count
  FROM AssigneeCounts
  WHERE assignee_name = (SELECT assignee_name FROM TopAssignee)
)
SELECT 
  filing_year AS year
FROM TopAssigneeYearlyCounts
ORDER BY app_count DESC, filing_year ASC
LIMIT 1;
